name: Tomato toast
intro: Thick sourdough, a ripe tomato, olive oil, salt. In July, that's dinner — add an egg if you want it to be.

proteins.name: Fried eggs
proteins.timing: Cooked in the same pan after the toast, about 3 minutes.

proteins.name: Burrata
proteins.timing: Torn over the hot toast. Nothing to cook.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a skillet and toast the bread, pressing it down, until golden and crisp.
Rub the cut garlic over the hot toast.
Eggs: crack them into the same pan and cook until the whites set. Burrata: tear it over the toast now.
Slice the tomato, lay it on, and salt it.
Your flavor on top, then the egg if you made one.

leftovers: Toast doesn't keep. Make it fresh.
